command:
printf '%s
' 'system:'; /usr/local/bin/codex --version 2>&1 || true; printf '%s
' 'desktop-bundled:'; /usr/lib/chatgpt/resources/codex --version 2>&1 || true; printf '%s
' 'standalone-releases:'; find $HOME/.codex/packages/standalone/releases -type f -path '*/bin/codex' -perm -u+x -print 2>/dev/null | sort -V | tail -n 5 | while read p; do printf '%s -> ' "$p"; "$p" --version 2>&1 || true; done
